A '''B1-series battle droid''' served under the [[Commanding officer|command]] of [[General]] [[Lok Durd]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. While stationed on the [[planet]] [[Maridun]], the [[battle droid]] was stationed in a [[Separatist command center]] and commanded his fellow units, only to be cut down by [[Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] in a [[Defense of Maridun|surprise attack]].<ref name="DoP" />
